uniqueStory.title: What makes us unique?
uniqueStory.desc: Since 1997, National Plasto has been making moulded plastic furniture for every space and every need. Four ISO-certified plants, four brands across price points and a Pan-India dealer network let us deliver durable, affordable furniture to homes, businesses and institutions across India.

hero.title: Built on Trust, Precision & 29 Years of Innovation
hero.subtitle: From a single moulding line to India's foremost polymer manufacturing powerhouse.

overview.title: Company Overview
overview.desc: Established in 1997, National Plasto Products Pvt. Ltd. has grown into one of eastern India's largest and most technologically advanced manufacturers of moulded plastic furniture, industrial crates, and custom polymer products. Headquartered in Kolkata with modern manufacturing plants across West Bengal, we cater to retail, institutional, and industrial clients throughout India.
